$description: Jellyfesh design tokens: the single source for Swift, Kotlin, C#, Rust and GTK CSS codegen. Base values come from the Misty Design Language 1.1 token file (Apache-2.0, (c) 2026 ZodiaCALs); groups below “brand” are Jellyfesh extensions. Everything marked status=proposed awaits approval. Modified from Misty: the org.misty extension is renamed org.jellyfesh, CSS custom-property names are removed, and Jellyfesh groups are added.

org.jellyfesh.colour-conversion: OKLCH to sRGB with the CSS Color 4 OKLab matrices, each channel clipped to 0..1 (matches Misty packages).
org.jellyfesh.hue: Theme colours are resolved at run time from one hue, derived from artwork by jf-palette (brand.hue-source).
